articles.title: Behind the Lens: The Tiny Desk Contest Tour’s Most Unforgettable Moments
articles.summary: From a singer’s emotional gaze to a crowd bathed in halo light, photographers reveal the raw, intimate moments of the Tiny Desk Contest tour. Cure for Paranoia headlined 10 cities, but the real story is in the unfiltered backstage chaos and onstage joy. One photo captures a musician speaking about his late mother under a starburst spotlight.

articles.title: Swatch’s Golden MoonSwatch Uses 1969 Gold Prices to Avoid Launch Chaos
articles.summary: Swatch’s new Mission to the Moon 1969 watch features 11 grams of 18K Moonshine Gold melted from vintage Omega parts — and it’s priced using 1969 gold rates, just $620. To prevent the frenzy of past launches, buyers must complete a 32-question ESTA application. Only 1,969 will be selected.

articles.title: From Sid the Sloth to Greek Epic: Why John Leguizamo’s Eumaeus Feels So Familiar
articles.summary: John Leguizamo, the voice behind Ice Age’s Sid and Encanto’s Bruno, takes on the role of blind swineherd Eumaeus in Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey. He describes Nolan’s no-phones set as intense but collaborative, with the director braving the elements alongside the cast. Leguizamo’s four-decade career spans everything from Miami Vice to John Wick.
